description: Read-only browse/enumerate of approved Nebula KB items (title, url, section, date when present). Use this when you want to page through a section or the full allowlist; use nebula_search_knowledge instead for ranked queries, nebula_get_section instead for full record content, nebula_get_overview instead for a summary. Returns items[{title,url,section,date?}], total, offset, limit, nextOffset.

section.description: Optional section id to list (one of: organization, people, services, industries, frameworks, research, externalAssets, pages, answers, caseStudies, blogs). Omit to list all approved sections.

name: nebula_list_knowledge
title: List Nebula knowledge
